verdict.rationale: Founder Law is an attorney-led immigration and startup law firm, and the evidence shows no natural-language command interface, assistant, or agentic way to operate its services. Its llms.txt only aids LLM discovery of site content, not command-driven operation. Intake runs through a standard assessment form and consultations, and the firm explicitly positions itself against automated legal tools. Because legal-service platforms can plausibly offer AI or chat-driven operation, the axis applies, and with no supporting evidence the verdict is none.
